verdict.rationale: JumpCloud's SSO page claims it enforces SSO and MFA across "all SAML and OIDC-based apps," which implies arbitrary SAML/OIDC apps beyond a fixed catalog. However, nothing explicitly documents custom-app configuration, and header-based apps are not mentioned at all. Missing for 10: explicit custom/non-catalog SAML app connector documentation, custom OIDC app setup, header-based app SSO support, step-by-step configuration walkthroughs, independent or hands-on corroboration of custom-app setup.

support.subject: As an IT admin, apps outside the catalog still get SSO — custom SAML, OIDC, and header-based apps configured with documented walkthroughs

citations.quote: Enforce SSO and multi-factor authentication (MFA) across all SAML and OIDC-based apps.
